caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a candlestick or lamp base, rendered in grayscale with shading to indicate form and dimension. The object is centrally positioned within a rectangular frame and stands vertically. Its structure consists of several distinct segments: at the bottom is a broad, flat, circular base, which supports a short, rounded spindle that tapers inward and then outward, transitioning into a cylindrical midsection with a slight lip at the top and bottom. The uppermost part narrows slightly and is capped by a flat top surface with two small, cylindrical protrusions rising vertically from it. The background within the primary frame is plain and light, while the outermost area of the paper shows some yellowing with age and minor spots. The artist's signature "Ewing" appears in the lower right corner of the inner frame.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
